fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Wooden Peacock – Rajasthani Decorative Sculpture - Small
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a touch of elegance and tradition to your space with this exquisite hand-carved wooden peacock from Rajasthan. Known as the national bird of India, the peacock symbolizes grace, prosperity, and beauty. Meticulously crafted by skilled artisans, the sculpture features a peacock with its majestic feathers beautifully fanned out in intricate detail. The delicate jali (lattice) work and fine hand-carving showcase the timeless artistry of Rajasthan, making it not just a decorative piece but a true work of art.
